d:
Bihar ke bhagalpur ki beti vanshika viraj ne apni mehnat aur hausle se ek aisi uplabdhi hasil ki hai, jis par pura desh garv kar raha hai. mahaj 20 sal ki umr men vanshika ne indigo eyarlains ke pratishthit kaidet paylat program men jagah banaee hai. khas bat yah hai ki chayan ke antim charan men bihar se chuni gaeen vah iklauti abhyarthi hain.
